task_title: Fix rendering depth, blood pool spread, and mob facing

plan_review.notes: Plan review by gpt-5.4 rubber-duck against the implemented diff. No blocking concerns. Two low-impact suggestions applied: (1) added ENTITY_DEPTH symbolic constant in src/shared/render-depths.ts so the corpse-EID-reuse depth reset in PhaserBridge no longer hardcodes 0 (future-proofs against entity-plane changes); (2) added per-lobe initialScale to BloodPoolLobe so outer lobes start at 0 and unfurl outward from the core lobe, rather than materialising already-spread on frame 0. Both changes covered by existing regression tests; full unit suite re-run clean (3919/3919 unit tests, verify:fast passing).

rounds.notes: Post-plan-review follow-up during PR #812 shepherding: the code-review agent reviewed the comment-only fix to the blood-pool redraw-guard comment in src/engine/GoreVfx.ts (addressing copilot-pull-request-reviewer thread PRRT_kwDOSvo2Ms6OhObB). Confirmed comment-only (no logic/threshold change) and that every number is accurate: at 16ms/60fps progress advances ~0.00053/frame and alpha ~0.00029/frame, both below the 0.001 redraw threshold, so neither crosses it in a single frame; progress is the faster driver and accumulates past 0.001 after ~2 frames, so a pool redraws roughly every other frame. 0 concerns; verify:fast green.
